latest.text: Play the PC version once, then you should get a bunch of folders in the PC version like application, arc, etc. Upload all those folders to PPSA92008. Filesystem stuff is weird on the PS5 and it has given me trouble trying to make extraction work on the PS5 itself. Basically, relative paths dont work, chdir doesnt work, and all paths must start with /app0/ which resolves to your app's PPSA/CUSA folder. I am also on 7.61 so there might be some differences there
